mapper.sql: from app a join `user` u on a.userId=u.id where a.isDelete=0 and u.isDelete=0
mapper.select: select a.* and a.deployKey=#{key} and a.deployedTime is not null
mapper.update: update app set appName=#{name},editTime=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id=#{id} and isDelete=0
update app set appName=#{name},priority=#{priority},editTime=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id=#{id} and isDelete=0
update app set isDelete=1 where id=#{id}
update app set isDelete=1 where userId=#{userId}
update app set deployKey=#{key},deployedTime=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id=#{id} and isDelete=0
update app set cover=#{cover} where id=#{id} and isDelete=0
mapper.select: select a.* order by a.priority desc,a.id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}
select deployKey from app where isDelete=0 and deployedTime is not null
select cover from app where isDelete=0 and cover is not null
